limitations: Diagnostic inference using an explicit cleaned-column adapter; exact training preprocessing equivalence remains unverified.
Source coordinates are unverified. Do not interpret these points as established Faustini coverage.
Training labels are rule-derived. Score is not independent evidence of water ice.
Source CPR and DOP are constant; this artifact has no CPR or DOP predictors.
Unobserved IIRS samples receive no score. Missing IIRS does not establish permanent shadow.
No interpolation, ice abundance estimate, probability calibration or LFM fusion is applied.
